string.text: Okay... Wow. I doubt you've ever held this kinda shooter in your hands... An enhanced AKS-74U. More precisely, AKS-74UBN: night optics (costs a lot) and PBS-1! I gave this Duty fella a ton of first aid kits to get my hands on this beauty. That was when Freedom pounded a Duty squad so bad that they actually ran out of meds. Three times this baby saved my life since then... This is definitely for me.
Here, the FNX-45 pistol! That's a nice gun. Yeah, you owe me another 2,800.
Here, FNX-45, with scope! That'll be another 2,800.
Look, it's a Desert Eagle, complete with collimator and compensator. It's an insane thing! The remaining 2,800 and it's yours.
Here's a Desert Eagle, with a collimator and compensator. That's a killer gun! Not easy, though. The remaining 2,800 and it's yours.
SIG Sauer P320 pistol in 45ACP caliber. It was produced in a small batch for an unknown special unit. The remaining 2,800 and it's yours.
Here, a SIG P320 45ACP. That'll be another 2,800.
Wait a second! Hey, R.P.D.! That'll be another 28,000.
Here: RPD machine gun. That'll be another 28,000.
Look, it's the VSSK "Vykhlop" sniper rifle! That's a big one. Well, 28,000 and it's yours.
Sure, VSSK "Vykhlop". The missing 28,000 and it's yours.
I believe this is exactly what you need. M79 grenade launcher! 28,000 and take it.
Sure. M-79. For 28,000.
Here, AK-12, new design. For 16,000, you can have it.
Here, AK-12. That'll be 16,000.
Here, a Groza 5.45. For 16,000, it's all yours.
Here's a 5.45 Groza with a tactical grip. That'll be 16,000.
Here: VSS Vintorez, with tactical grip and butt pad for easy aiming. Another 16,000.
Of course. Here: VSS Vintorez, tactical. For the missing 16,000.
Here: Barrett M98 Bravo! Look how big it is. Well, 32,000 and it's yours.
Of course. Here: Barrett M98 Bravo, strong stuff.... 32,000 short, and it's yours.
Here, L96A1, popularly known as the AWP. Don't ask me where I got it. You owe me another 32,000.
Uh-huh. L96A1 sniper rifle. You owe me another 32,000.
Here you go - Winchester 1892, brought from afar! You owe me the remaining 32,000.
Look what I got! Winchester 1892, a rarity! You owe me the remaining 32,000.
A heavy weapon.
Sure thing. The price is 30,000, and I'll need 2,000 of that in advance.
You refused to pick up your last order... So this one will cost you 26,000, and I'll need 4,000 of that in advance.
A tactical weapon.
Tactical? Well, I have something in mind... The regular price is 20,000, with a 4,000 advance payment. What do you say?
